title: No DuckDB/H2 file-engine confinement in core: admin datasource + schema can read host files and reach the network

criteria.given: a DuckDB datasource opened by Saiku with default settings
criteria.then: core adds enable_external_access=false, an allowed_directories list confined to saiku.home and lock_configuration=true, and applies it in every connection-open path

criteria.given: an H2 datasource URL whose database file lies outside saiku.home
criteria.then: the JdbcUrlPolicy chokepoint rejects it unless the operator has opted out

criteria.given: an operator who needs the previous behaviour
criteria.then: an explicit saiku.jdbc.fileEngineConfinement=false opt-out exists and is documented in docs/operator-hardening.md
